name: expert-team-foundry
description: A foundry that turns a requirement into a ready-to-use WorkBuddy expert team, and then keeps that team honest: scopes role boundaries, matches the best available skill for each member, builds the spec-compliant package, gates it through runtime skill-binding verification, runs a nine-dimension capability baseline before delivery, and adjudicates version iterations with a nine-dimension quantitative capability score (with dedicated iteration-governance and naming-convention dimensions).

displayDescription.en: Turns a requirement into a ready-to-use expert team, and adjudicates version iterations with a nine-dimension quantitative capability score.
displayDescription.zh: 需求铸团、按人配置最优技能、生成合规包体，并以九维量化评分客观裁决版本迭代该不该合入

defaultInitPrompt.en: Build me an expert team for this requirement:

quickPrompts.en: Build me an expert team for this requirement:

quickPrompts.zh: 给我这个专家团的每个角色挑最合适的技能，并确认在本机真的能用
quickPrompts.en: Pick the best available skill for every member and confirm it actually runs locally

quickPrompts.zh: 对比这个专家团的两个版本，判断这次迭代到底有没有变强、有没有哪一维退步
quickPrompts.en: Diff two versions of this expert team and tell me whether the iteration actually improved it
